title: Indicator catalogue (canonical)
description: Hand-authored canonical indicator catalogue (taxonomy/indicators.json). One row per indicator_id. Carries the full Hans honesty surface (D15) plus D29 catalogue additions (parent_indicator_id self-FK, dimension_values:STRUCT for facet-explode children, per-child source_id, methodology_version FK). id field enforces the D30 naming convention. Pipeline compiles to taxonomy/indicators.parquet. NOTE: this is the canonical replacement for the pre-pivot datasets/schemas/indicator.schema.json (which validates per-shard JSON under datasets/indicators/in/). The legacy file stays in place through Phase 0.13; rename of this file to indicator.schema.json happens when the pre-pivot artifacts move to _old/.

x-changelog.description: Initial canonical indicator catalogue schema (Phase 0.3 of TODO/20260517-canonical-long-format-pivot.md). Carries D15 honesty surface + D29 additions: parent_indicator_id self-FK for facet-explode parents/children (D26), dimension_values:STRUCT populated iff parent_indicator_id IS NOT NULL, per-child source_id (D29 -- siblings can have different upstreams), methodology_version FK to methodology-breaks.json (D28). id pattern enforces D30 kebab-case, single-segment, <=60 chars. dimension_values keys MUST appear in taxonomy/facet-axes.json registry (D31 -- enforced by validator, not by JSON Schema). coverage_* columns are denormalised at every emit so the catalogue stays browseable from DuckDB-WASM without scanning observation Parquet.

T.3 indicator catalogue widening (TODO/20260517-canonical-long-format-pivot.md §0e.7). ADDITIVE: two new optional fields on indicator rows. (a) id_aliases: list[string] of legacy indicator_id slugs (typically the pre-pivot '<topic>/<id>' form, e.g. 'fiscal/outstanding_debt_pct_gsdp') that resolve to this row for back-compat URL / query dereferencing. Each alias must match the kebab pattern OR carry a single slash for the legacy '<topic>/<snake_case_id>' shape. (b) deprecated_in: ISO date string 'YYYY-MM-DD' naming the day the alias chain was introduced; Tier-B check tier_b_indicator_alias_window REJECTS rows whose deprecated_in is older than 60 days (one-release back-compat window per Gregor strict default — locked 2026-05-22 user direction Q3). Both fields purely additive (not in required[]); v1.0 rows validate unchanged under v1.1.

PR-B1 grain-over-entity rip-and-replace (docs/archive/plans/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md Phase B). BREAKING: (a) ADD required entity_kinds:array<enum> + default_entity_kind:enum -- enum is {country,state,district,ac,party,candidate}. Grain lives on the row, not in the indicator_id (ADR-0044). (b) REMOVE id_aliases + deprecated_in (per-PR rename scripts under tools/migrate/ replace the one-release alias window). v1.x rows DO NOT validate under v2.0 -- the catalogue is backfilled in the same commit. Tier-B tier_b_indicator_id_no_grain_prefix ships dark in PR-B1, enforces post-PR-B9; it rejects indicator_id matching ^(state|district|national)- so the grain axis is structurally enforced.

PR-Z3b-tail-actionC update_period_days backfill (docs/archive/plans/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md §0quat guardrail #18). ADDITIVE: ADD optional integer property update_period_days (minimum=1) -- publisher refresh cadence in days (NDLM monthly = 30, RBI Handbook annual = 365, Census decennial = 3650). All 183 existing rows backfilled in same commit via cadence-derivation (annual_fy=365, monthly_cy=30, ad_hoc=365 default annual review). Unlocks chaining the existing DARK tier_b_indicator_freshness_declared check live in a follow-up PR. concept_id FK + meta.justification deferred to a later PR; v2.0 rows continue to validate unchanged under v2.1.

PR-Z3b-tail-conceptFK Carve 0a schema-only bump (docs/archive/plans/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md §0quat guardrail #13). ADDITIVE: ADD optional string property concept_id (kebab-case, single segment, maxLength=40) -- FK to datasets/taxonomy/concepts.json declaring (noun, unit_canonical, normalisation, entity_kinds) per ADR-0044 doctrine 'identity is what is MEASURED, not who published it'. No catalogue rows backfilled in this PR; the field is optional during the v2.1->v2.2 transition. Intent is required-once-backfilled, enforced via the DARK Tier-B check tier_b_one_indicator_per_concept (added in PR-Z3b-tail3 #366) which will chain live in a follow-up PR once Carve 1 ships the 183-row backfill via the Z3a find_overlap confidence>=0.95 clustering + stub-concepts auto-mint path. v2.1 rows continue to validate unchanged under v2.2 (consumer indicators.json stamp bumped 2.1->2.2 to satisfy Tier-B `$schema_version == x-version` invariant; no row carries concept_id until Carve 1 lands).

PR-Zjust meta.justification backfill (docs/archive/plans/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md §0quat guardrail #15). ADDITIVE: ADD optional object property meta with optional string sub-property justification (minLength=20). Backfills meta.justification on the 26 cross-grain twin rows (5x coal/gas/hydro/nuclear/renewable installed-capacity attribution facets + 2x vote-share + 2x winning-party) naming the structural difference per guardrail #15 (different concept / unit / normalisation / sampling frame). Unlocks chaining the existing DARK Tier-B check tier_b_indicator_has_justification (added in PR-Z3b-tail-actionBD #367) live in run(). v2.2 rows continue to validate unchanged under v2.3.

PR-A3c-tail-2 (#408) renderer_rules rip on the catalogue side (companion to PR #407 which ripped from per-shard indicator.schema.json + ingest writers). MAJOR per CLAUDE.md §11 (property removal): REMOVE optional array property renderer_rules from the indicators[] item shape. Per ADR-0045 (grapher catalogue split), render hints belong in datasets/grapher/indicator_render.json owned by the frontend, not in the canonical indicator catalogue. All 22 catalogue rows that previously carried renderer_rules are mechanically stripped in the same commit; the field is preserved verbatim on the grapher side (datasets/schemas/grapher-indicator-render.schema.json) which is its canonical home. Catalogue model backend/yen_gov/canonical/indicators_seed.py drops the IndicatorRow.renderer_rules field, the renderer_rules VARCHAR[] DDL column, and the _row_to_tuple emission. taxonomy/indicators.parquet regenerated via emit-taxonomy (one column fewer). v2.3 rows that carry renderer_rules DO NOT validate under v2.4; the catalogue is backfilled in the same commit. Stamp in consumer datasets/taxonomy/indicators.json bumped 2.3 -> 2.4.

indicator_id.description: PK. D30 naming convention: <entity>-<measure>-<unit>-<facet>, kebab-case, single segment, max 60 chars. Approved abbreviations: nsdp, gsdp, cpi, imr, mmr, tfr, mw, gwh, mu, inr, pct. New abbreviations require Max sign-off. Methodology-version children encode the version (e.g. 'state-gsdp-base-2011-12-inr-crore'). Greppable; deterministic; no hash.

description_short.description: One-line summary of what the indicator IS. OWID separates label from description.

description_long.description: Paragraph-form definition + methodology pointer. Surfaced on the indicator page.

cadence.description: Per ADR-0027 + D15. Publisher's release cadence. decennial / ad_hoc series have no defined inter-observation interval — derive_temporal_range() omits gap_count for these.

default_period_seq_for_cadence.description: When multiple cadences coexist for this indicator (e.g. monthly + annual), the period_seq the chart picks by default. Null when not applicable.

family.description: Storage axis (e.g. 'elections', 'energy', 'fiscal'). Partition column when family Parquet > 15 MB (D8).

pillar.description: Curation axis for the citizen-facing browse. Distinct from family (storage axis).

denominator.description: For rates/ratios: what they are per (e.g. 'population_total', 'gsdp_current_inr_crore'). Free-text; may be an indicator_id or a publisher-defined denominator.

attribution_geography.description: What the entity_id geographically represents per Hans review. Renderer surfaces banner for where_produced / where_allocated / where_billed to prevent siting-as-service misreading.

comparability.description: Hans 4-level honesty ladder. directional_only suppresses rank-table views and labels the choropleth 'illustrative, not a ranking'.

implementing_authority.description: Who actually executes vs who funds (see funding_split). Many CSS schemes are centre-funded but state-implemented = joint.

funding_split.description: Centre-vs-state attribution. Critical so a citizen reading 'state X is doing well' knows whether the state government, the Centre, or a CSS drove it.

methodology_vintage.description: Short string naming the methodology revision (e.g. 'GSDP base 2011-12'). Distinct from observation year — a 2024 NFHS-6 figure has the same year as a 2024 NFHS-5 backcast but different vintage.

revision_tier.description: Publisher's revision-tier discipline for this indicator. 'mixed' when rows span tiers (each row carries its own vintage on the observation).

excluded_notes.description: Citizen-facing what's-NOT-counted bullets (Hans framing). e.g. 'IGNOAPS / IGNWPS social pensions excluded'.

parent_indicator_id.description: D26 facet-explode self-FK. null for parent indicators; populated for facet-explode children. When non-null, dimension_values MUST be non-null (validator-enforced).

dimension_values.description: D29. Populated iff parent_indicator_id IS NOT NULL. Keys MUST appear in taxonomy/facet-axes.json registry (D31 — validator-enforced, not JSON Schema). e.g. {fuel_type: 'coal'} for a 'state-installed-capacity-mw-coal' child of 'state-installed-capacity-mw'.

methodology_version.description: D28. FK to methodology-breaks.json. Together with id-encoded break (D30 puts the version in the id) gives the chart shell both the splice-marker (visible vertical rule via D32) and the prose narrative.

methodology_break_ids.description: FK[] -> methodology-breaks.json. All breaks active across this series (a long series can cross multiple).

source_id.description: D29 — per-child source_id (NOT shared across siblings). coal-capacity from CEA and solar-capacity from MNRE are siblings of one parent with different sources. null on the parent row; required on each child.

coverage_states_count.description: Denormalised at every emit. Supports the catalogue's 'has data for >=80% states' filter without scanning observation Parquet from the browser.

coverage_year_min.description: Denormalised. Earliest observation year for this indicator.

coverage_density.description: Denormalised. Fraction of (eligible_entity x year) cells observed. 1.0 = complete; 0.0 = empty.

entity_kinds.description: v2.0 (PR-B1 2026-05-26 grain-over-entity rip per ADR-0044). The entity kinds this indicator can be observed at. Grain is dispatched at READ time from each observation row's entity_kind column -- never encoded in indicator_id. After Phase-B collapse pairs, the same indicator_id can carry e.g. [country, state, district] when one fact is observed at three grains. enum widened beyond {country,state,district,ac} to {party,candidate} because election-class indicators (party-vote-share-pct, candidate-rank) treat the party/candidate as the entity per ADR-0044 Standing Reference. Tier-B tier_b_indicator_id_no_grain_prefix (PR-B1 dark, PR-B9 enforced) rejects ^(state|district|national)- prefixes on the id so the grain axis lives ONLY here.

default_entity_kind.description: v2.0 (PR-B1 2026-05-26). The default grain a chart picks when the user has not chosen one. MUST be a member of entity_kinds (Tier-B-enforced once PR-B5 lands the multi-kind rows).

update_period_days.description: v2.1 (PR-Z3b-tail-actionC 2026-05-26). Publisher refresh cadence in days (NDLM monthly = 30, RBI Handbook annual = 365, Census decennial = 3650). Operator dashboard surfaces stale indicators when today - last_observed > 2 * update_period_days. Required-in-practice via the DARK Tier-B check tier_b_indicator_freshness_declared (added in PR-Z3b-cli #363; chained live in a follow-up PR once all 183 rows are backfilled). OWID precedent: every Grapher variable carries this. Optional in schema for the v2.0->v2.1 transition; intent is required.

concept_id.description: v2.2 (PR-Z3b-tail-conceptFK Carve 0a 2026-05-26). FK to datasets/taxonomy/concepts.json. Identity is what is MEASURED, not who published it (ADR-0044). Per guardrail #13: every indicator MUST FK to one row in concepts.json declaring (noun, unit_canonical, normalisation, entity_kinds); run `python -m yen_gov check-overlap` before authoring any new row, and UPSERT into an existing indicator or add a facet if a concept match >=70% exists. Optional in v2.2 for the schema/backfill split; intent-required is enforced via the DARK Tier-B check tier_b_one_indicator_per_concept (added in PR-Z3b-tail3 #366; chained live once Carve 1 lands the 183-row backfill).

justification.description: v2.3 (PR-Zjust 2026-05-26). Per guardrail #15: when an indicator shares concept_id with another indicator that has a different entity_kinds tuple, the row MUST carry meta.justification naming the structural difference (different concept / unit / normalisation / sampling frame / attribution facet). Without justification the twin is a proliferation bug and the right action is to merge via cross-grain entity_kinds[] on the original row. Enforced live by Tier-B tier_b_indicator_has_justification (chained into run() in this PR).

meta.description: v2.3 (PR-Zjust 2026-05-26). Free-form structured metadata. Today only carries justification (guardrail #15); future fields will be added additively.
